assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carson has an unmistakable voice. She works across the verse-novel, lyric essay, drama and translation from classical Greek. Autobiography of Red recasts the Geryon myth as a modern queer love story in verse. Nox is a book-object elegy for her brother that merges translation, scholarship and memory. Her handling of form is among the most inventive in contemporary English-language writing. She combines classical learning with emotional exposure, which fits the range of imaginative and intellectual depth the will calls for.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would fit well, centered on formal reinvention of the relation between classical inheritance and contemporary lyric and narrative. The work crosses genres, so the citation would need to name the hybrid practice rather than any one genre.
assessment.maturity: She has a substantial body of work over several decades, and the major books have stayed in circulation. The oeuvre is consistently high-quality but often short or fragmentary in scale. Its sustained development into later work is the main thing to weigh.
uncertainties: Much of the effect depends on typography, book design and layout. Not all of it is captured in a summary or a citation.
Her translations from Greek and other languages are part of the corpus. Their weight relative to the original work is a judgment call.
I have not independently verified the later publications.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cărtărescu's prose is visionary and densely patterned. Blinding (the Orbitor trilogy) and the very large Solenoid build a metaphysical project from the body, memory, childhood and dream. The scale of ambition, the linguistic richness and the metaphysical depth are all exceptional. He also began as a poet, and that background shows in the cadence of his prose.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation could point to a visionary, encyclopedic reinvention of the Romanian novel. The poetry, the stories and the novels share an imaginative world, so the credit is coherent.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a strong late phase. Solenoid shows that the mature work has kept its ambition and intensity.
uncertainties: Judgments of his Romanian prose style rely largely on translations, and the density of the language may not survive them fully.
Some of the very long novels risk excess or repetition. Whether that is a weakness or a strength is debatable.
Coverage of the poetry and essays in translation is thinner.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Zurita's poetry, from Purgatorio through Anteparaíso and later books, transforms the experience of dictatorship and mass suffering into a very large memorial form. His work also extends beyond the page: skywriting, a desert inscription and other landscape-scale pieces. The poetry has a distinctive visionary voice, with a lasting moral and historical weight that rests on the strength of the poems themselves.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would fit, centered on poetry that makes catastrophe and collective memory into new form. It would include both the books and the landscape pieces.
assessment.maturity: A career of several decades with a consistent project. Later work has continued to develop rather than repeat.
uncertainties: The landscape and skywriting works are ephemeral or remote, so they can be judged only through documentation.
His intensity and prophetic register may lose force in translation.
Political and historical context bears heavily on how the work is read. It should support the literary case, not replace it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Yan uses grotesque, satirical and mythic forms to expose the violence of ideology, bureaucracy and development in modern China. Works such as The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles are formally inventive. His own concept of 'mythorealism', set out in essays, gives his practice a theoretical frame. The imaginative reach and the sustained critique are significant.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation could name his transformation of Chinese realism through satire and myth. Essays and fiction are both relevant.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a strong body of mature novels. Consistent in ambition across several decades.
uncertainties: He is read mostly through a limited set of translations, so I am uncertain about the full corpus.
Some works have been banned or limited in China. That should not count as literary merit in itself.
The unevenness between the more experimental and the more conventional books is hard to assess from translations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Wright writes large polyphonic novels, notably Carpentaria and The Swan Book, which bring Aboriginal storytelling, sovereignty and ecological time into the English novel. Her voice is distinctive and her formal ambition is real. She also writes nonfiction and collective memoir, which extends the range of the body of work.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would fit, centered on a reimagining of the novel through Indigenous narrative and political imagination. She is the credited writer, though some of her projects are collaborative or collective in character.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is moderate in number of volumes but significant in scale and depth. The question is whether the breadth is already sufficient.
uncertainties: The number of major novels is smaller than for some others on the list.
I have not independently verified her most recent work.
The weight of cultural and political significance should be kept separate from the literary evaluation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Erdrich has built a long, interlinked fictional world of Ojibwe and settler families across many novels, including Love Medicine and The Night Watchman. Her work joins communal memory, humour, legal and political power, and an inventive handling of multiple voices. Sustained quality across a long span is a clear strength, and she also writes poetry.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation could name the creation of a connected narrative world of Native American life. The credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A very mature oeuvre with continued strong work. Few doubts about durability.
uncertainties: It is hard to judge from a summary whether formal innovation matches the best of the others ranked here.
The size of the oeuvre means my knowledge of lesser books is incomplete.
Her poetry and children's writing have less attention in my assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Can Xue writes dreamlike, uncompromising fiction that destabilizes ordinary psychology, space and causality. The voice is original and she has held to an experimental line over decades. Her work asks a lot of the reader, which is part of its force. She is also a critic of Western and Chinese literature.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation could name the radical reimagining of fiction as inner, dream-like structure. The credit is clear.
assessment.maturity: A long and consistent career. Her aesthetic has stayed remarkably stable, which can read as either depth or limited range.
uncertainties: Translation is a heavy filter, since her prose depends on odd syntax and image.
Only part of her very large output has been translated.
It is hard to judge variation between works from the translated sample.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adonis changed the possibilities of modern Arabic poetry through myth, fragmentation and a continuing dialogue with the classical tradition. Collections such as Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses have been central to modern Arabic verse. His critical and theoretical essays on the Arabic poetic heritage add intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation could name the renewal of Arabic poetic language and form. Poetry and essays are both part of the achievement.
assessment.maturity: An exceptionally long career with a clear historical significance. The question is whether recent work matches the earlier peak.
uncertainties: His formal achievement is tied to the Arabic poetic tradition and is very hard to assess in translation.
Translated selections may not represent the full range of his collections.
His public and political statements are not the basis for a literary judgment.
